notes: mode: source | registry | local. See docs/pinning.md. registry mode stays unusable until something is actually pushed to ghcr.io/spdrman/backup-manager, so source is the only honest default today. Moved from 6a93b96 to 2b93c4a because the old pin predated the whole backup-set command: MATRIX.md records the create row as proved by specs/backup-set-create.spec.ts, and that spec cannot run against a build whose answer to `backup-set create` is `unknown command`. A matrix row is only as true as the build the suite resolves, so the pin has to move with the row.
